en.title: Accesstive Launches End-to-End Accessibility Platform for Modern Web Teams
en.summary: Accesstive has launched an end-to-end accessibility platform designed to help modern web teams ensure digital content meets accessibility standards. In related news, Yale Summer Cabaret has been renovated to provide wheelchair-accessible seating and ramps for the production of Hedwig and the Angry Inch. Meanwhile, 26 disabled athletes in Keelung are attempting a canoe crossing to promote inclusive marine recreation, and a new guide outlines steps for installing home lifts to improve residential accessibility.

zh-TW.title: Accesstive 推出端到端無障礙平台，助網頁團隊達標
zh-TW.summary: Accesstive 推出端到端無障礙平台，協助現代網頁團隊確保數位內容符合無障礙標準。耶魯夏季歌劇院改造成無障礙夜店，提供輪椅坡道和座位，以上演《Hedwig and the Angry Inch》。基隆二十六位身障勇士挑戰獨木舟勇渡基隆嶼，推動海洋休閒無障礙。另外，一則來自日本帳號的 Twitter 討論探討遺傳疾病與殘障史，提供最新的研究觀察。
